tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: Automated Trade Moment Creation
stories.goal: automatically detect and create feed moments when trades are completed in the external fantasy platform
stories.benefit: league members see trade activity in their feed without manual posting, keeping everyone informed of roster changes
acceptanceCriteria: System polls Sleeper API and detects new completed trades
Trade moment is created with involved teams, players traded, and timestamp
Trade moment appears in league newsfeed with appropriate formatting
Trade moments include all players and draft picks involved in the transaction
System handles multi-team trades correctly

stories.title: Automated Match Result Moments
stories.goal: automatically create feed moments when weekly matchups are completed and scored
stories.benefit: league members see match results prominently in their feed, driving engagement and conversation
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when a matchup score is finalized after stat corrections
Match result moment is created with final scores, winning team, and week identifier
Moment includes key stats like point differential and notable performances if available
System waits for stat correction period before finalizing result moments
Match result moments are prominently displayed in the feed

stories.title: Automated Waiver Transaction Moments
stories.goal: automatically generate moments for waiver wire claims and free agent pickups
stories.benefit: league members stay informed about roster moves and waiver activity across all teams
acceptanceCriteria: System detects new waiver claims when they process in the external platform
Waiver moment includes team, player added, player dropped (if applicable), and priority used
Free agent pickups are captured separately from waiver claims
Moments include timestamp and relevant transaction metadata
Multiple simultaneous waiver claims are handled correctly

stories.title: Playoff Advancement Moments
stories.goal: automatically create moments when teams clinch playoffs or are eliminated
stories.benefit: major league milestones are celebrated or acknowledged in the feed, increasing emotional engagement
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when a team clinches a playoff spot based on standings and schedule
Playoff clinching moment is created with team info, seed if determinable, and timing
Elimination moments are created when teams are mathematically eliminated
Moments are only created once per team per milestone to avoid duplicates
System handles different playoff formats (standard bracket, toilet bowl, etc.)

stories.title: Championship and Runner-Up Moments
stories.goal: automatically create celebratory moments when playoff championships and runner-up positions are decided
stories.benefit: league championship is properly celebrated and documented in the feed and history
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when championship matchup is completed
Championship moment is created with winner, runner-up, final scores, and season identifier
Third place and consolation bracket winners are also recognized if applicable
Championship moments are marked as major milestones and persist in league history
System supports both winners and losers/toilet bowl bracket champions

stories.title: Moment Deduplication Logic
stories.goal: prevent duplicate moments from being created for the same event during data sync cycles
stories.benefit: feed remains clean without redundant or duplicate event posts
acceptanceCriteria: System checks if a moment already exists for a specific event before creating a new one
Deduplication logic uses event type, timestamp, and involved entities as unique identifiers
Existing moments can be updated if data changes (e.g., stat corrections) without creating duplicates
System handles edge cases like trades being modified or cancelled
Deduplication logs are maintained for debugging and audit purposes

stories.title: Moment Type Classification and Formatting
stories.goal: correctly classify and format different types of automated moments with appropriate styling and metadata
stories.benefit: moments are easily distinguishable and formatted consistently for optimal user experience
acceptanceCriteria: Each moment type (trade, match result, waiver, playoff milestone, championship) has a distinct classification
Moments include appropriate icons, colors, or visual indicators based on type
Moment text is auto-generated with proper grammar and league-specific terminology
Metadata includes event timestamp, involved entities, and relevant stats
Moments are tagged for filtering and searchability

stories.title: Retroactive Moment Correction on Stat Changes
stories.goal: update or create corrected moments when NFL stat corrections change match outcomes or transaction timing
stories.benefit: feed reflects accurate results even when stat corrections occur, maintaining trust and accuracy
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when a stat correction changes a match winner
Original match result moment is marked as corrected or superseded
New corrected moment is created explaining the stat correction and new outcome
Pick'ems grading and commissioner prediction grading triggers are updated accordingly
Users are notified when moments they engaged with are corrected
